title: axillaryLN Fuzzy Workspace: Axillary Lymph Node Involvement Fuzzy Inference Interface (v1.0)
description: Version 1.0 of a browser-based research and reproducibility interface for the axillary lymph-node fuzzy inference model. The interface evaluates the locked V3 nodal, primary-tumour, and final Mamdani FIS files locally in the browser. Research use only — not for clinical use. This software is not a medical device and must not be used for clinical decision-making, diagnosis, or patient management.
